# Come Again Tours and Travels

> Uganda's premier licensed tour operator for Mountain Gorilla Trekking in Bwindi, Murchison Falls Safaris, Queen Elizabeth National Park Wildlife, Chimpanzee Tracking in Kibale, and 4x4 Safari Car Hire across East Africa. Based in Kampala, Uganda. Licensed by Uganda Tourism Board (UTB) & Association of Uganda Tour Operators (AUTO).

## About Us
Come Again Tours and Travels Ltd is a registered inbound tour operator and DMC based in Kampala, Uganda. We specialize in bespoke mountain gorilla safaris, chimpanzee trekking, savannah wildlife game drives, Nile boat cruises, mountain hiking, birdwatching expeditions, and reliable 4x4 safari car hire with seasoned local safari driver-guides across Uganda, Rwanda, Kenya, and Tanzania.

- [Website](https://www.comeagaintoursandtravels.com)

- **Email:** info@comeagaintoursandtravels.com

- **TripAdvisor Rating:** 5.0 / 5.0 (Excellent)

## Core Safari Experiences & Key Offerings

### 1. Mountain Gorilla Trekking (Bwindi Impenetrable & Mgahinga)
- Direct permit reservation through Uganda Wildlife Authority (UWA).
- Official 2026/2027 permit rates: Foreign Non-Resident: $800 USD, Foreign Resident: $700 USD, East African Citizen: UGX 300,000. Gorilla Habituation Experience (4 hours with gorillas): $1,500 USD.
- 3 to 5-day private itineraries with 4x4 transport, luxury/mid-range lodge bookings, and permit securing.

### 2. Big Five Savannah Safaris & Nile Waterfalls
- **Murchison Falls National Park:** Game drives, boat cruise to the base of the world's most powerful waterfall, top of the falls hike, delta cruises.
- **Queen Elizabeth National Park:** Tree-climbing lions in Ishasha, Kazinga Channel boat safari with world's highest hippo concentration, Kasenyi plains game drives.
- **Kidepo Valley & Lake Mburo:** Remote frontier wilderness safaris and walking safaris.

### 3. Primate Safaris (Kibale Forest Chimpanzees)
- Chimpanzee tracking in Kibale Forest (over 1,500 wild chimpanzees and 13 primate species).
- Chimpanzee Habituation Experience (CHEX) and Bigodi Wetland sanctuary walks.

### 4. 4x4 Safari Car Hire with Professional Driver-Guides
- Custom-fitted Safari Land Cruisers with pop-up photography roofs, high-lift jacks, dual spare wheels, mini-fridge/cooler, and charging sockets.
- Toyota Super Custom & Safari Hiace Minivans for families and small groups.
- English, German, French, and Spanish-speaking certified safari guides.
